# PetPlay / 펫플레이

> A free, ad-free local digital pet with no account and no generative AI.
> Build a sprite from SVG parts (dog / cat / bunny / bird / fox; ears, eyes,
> body, tail, accessory, three colours) or crop and tint your own photo on
> this device, name the pet, and care for it with Feed, Play, Pet and Clean
> against visible fullness / happiness / energy / cleanliness meters that
> drift down over time. Export a JSON backup.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://petplay.try-dabble.com/
The pet's look, name, needs and preferences stay in this browser on this
device. No accounts, no sign-in, no uploads, no server storage, no ads, no
in-app purchases, no tokens, no paid parts or skins, and no generative AI or
cloud portrait: the art is a fixed set of SVG shapes, or your own photo
cropped by your browser. Export a JSON backup to survive a reinstall or move
phones.

## Pages

- [Home](https://petplay.try-dabble.com/): The pet
- [Privacy](https://petplay.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy

- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/en/guides/petplay): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Parts sprite: five species, five ear styles, five eye styles, three bodies, four tails, five accessories, palette swatches plus a free colour picker for body / belly / accent; all free, no tokens
- Photo sprite: pick a local image, square crop with zoom and offset sliders, optional tint, rendered on a canvas in the browser and saved as an inline image; never uploaded, no AI
- Name the pet (up to 24 characters)
- Needs: fullness, happiness, energy, cleanliness from 0 to 100, shown as bars; they drift down while the tab is open and, capped, for time away
- Care: Feed (+fullness), Play (+happiness, −a little energy), Pet (+energy, +happiness), Clean (+cleanliness); a "Skip 1 hour" demo button and a "pause drift" toggle
- Mood face and speech bubble follow the meters (happy / okay / sad / hungry / sleepy / needs a wash / bored)
- JSON export / import of pet + needs + preferences; delete all
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
